card.statement:
Let $M$ be a $2\times 2$ canonical matrix for *congruence.

- If each neighborhood of $M$ contains a matrix whose *congruence canonical form is $N$, then there is a directed path from $M$ to $N$ in <<ref:g1>> (if $M=N$, then there is always the ``lazy'' path of length $0$ from $M$ to $N$).

- The closure of the *congruence class of $M$ is equal to the union of the *congruence classes of all canonical matrices $N$ such that there is a directed path from $N$ to $M$ (if $M=N$ then there is always the ``lazy'' path).
card.label: Remark 2

paper.title: Change of the *congruence canonical form of 2-by-2 matrices under perturbations
paper.abstract: We study how small perturbations of a 2-by-2 complex matrix can change its canonical form for *congruence. We construct the Hasse diagram for the closure ordering on the set of *congruence classes of 2-by-2 matrices.
